plugins.name: Pyr Prop Bets
plugins.summary: Prop bets on your Pyr server: games, crypto, the weather and more that open and settle by themselves, parlays of them, and props of your own, with your Pyr Casino chips.
plugins.description: Bet your Pyr Casino chips on what happens next. A server's casino can run props by itself: NFL, NBA, NHL, MLB, college football and basketball, crypto, the weather, science, the world's numbers, entertainment and art. They open, close and settle on their own from public sources, once whoever manages the server turns them on, and Pyr Casino has props about itself. Anyone can still open a prop of their own in a channel: a question with two to six outcomes. The odds move with every bet, from a market maker the server keeps (a logarithmic market scoring rule, as in Maanix's PlayProps), and every winning share pays a chip. Pyr Prop Bets' window, inside Pyr or popped out, has a front page, a board for each category, a search box, a page for each prop with how its odds went, your bets with what they're worth now (Cash out sells them back), the server's best at props, and results. Parlays link two to ten of the casino's own props into one bet: every pick has to win, their odds multiply, and a pick that's called off counts as 1.00. With it installed, props show in chat as cards with their odds and Bet, and /prop opens one. Parlays need Pyr 0.16.0 or newer, yours and the server's.
plugins.author: Maanix
plugins.review: Built by Firelit Games from Pyr's own source. It only shows props and asks Pyr to bet: the server checks every bet.
